notes: LATENCY, FIXED AT THE SOURCE: the sampled instruments had silence baked into the front of their MP3s (28ms grand piano, 46ms guitar, 71ms pad) — every sampled note spoke late no matter how fast the audio path was. Each sample's lead-in is now measured once and playback starts past it: the grand, guitars and the whole Jam band speak the instant you (or the beat) hit. DRUM MAPPING FIXED: keyboard drumming now uses the WHITE KEYS — C D E F G A B are kick/snare/clap/hat/open-hat/toms, any black key is the crash (the snare was hiding on C#). And PADS MOVED to the Instrument tab (Neck / Tab / Notation / Keys / Pads) — it's an instrument; the Studio keeps driving it when a drum track is armed.
